SEBI SEBI

The Securities and Exchange Board of India, the regulator that protects investors and oversees markets.

हिंदी में: SEBI

भारतीय प्रतिभूति और विनिमय बोर्ड, जो निवेशकों की रक्षा करता है और बाज़ार की निगरानी करता है।

How it is used in the lessons

Broker: a SEBI-registered firm that takes your orders and sends them to the exchange.

From Stock Market Foundations

Only SEBI-registered Investment Advisers (RIA) and Research Analysts (RA) may give you paid personalised advice or stock recommendations.

From Market Rules & Investor Protection

Regulation: mutual funds in India are regulated by SEBI and sold through registered distributors or directly.
